messages:
amy_sales: Mike on the PoC call is getting 403 project-claim errors when hitting /v1/generate. Can infra take a quick look?

mike_acme: "403 Forbidden: project claim mismatch" — using key from portal and header X-Redwood-Project: acme-poc.

carlos_infra: paste the curl (mask key) so I can check headers quickly.

mike_acme: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk.test.9xx" -H "X-Redwood-Project: acme-poc" -d '{"model":"redwood-lite","input":"hi"}'

zara_se: brief note: trial/presales keys sometimes bind to an internal project name (acme-temp). We tightened enforcement last quarter.

carlos_infra: looking at auth logs: bound_project=acme-temp header=acme-poc decision=DENY.

dev_support: quick workaround: call with X-Redwood-Project: acme-temp or we can rebind the key to acme-poc. Which does the customer prefer?

amy_sales: customer prefers rebind to avoid code changes during demo. Carlos can you rebind and relax demo throttles?

carlos_infra: will rebind now and apply a temporary demo uplift (200rpm) for 2 hours. Rebind done at ts=1775553360, action id=reb_2201.

mike_acme: confirmed 200 OK with original header (acme-poc). Thanks everyone. Please share audit entry and uplift window.

amy_sales: will send docs + pricing follow-up. Closing thread once audit link posted. :thumbsup:
